test_set_axis_name_mi: test renaming axis names on a MultiIndex Series using rename_axis and _set_axis_name
test_set_axis_name_raises: test that _set_axis_name raises ValueError for invalid axis on a Series
test_get_bool_data_preserve_dtype: test that _get_bool_data preserves boolean dtype on a Series
test_bool_series_ambiguous: test that bool(series) raises ValueError for ambiguous truth value on single and multi-element Series
test_metadata_propagation_resample: test that metadata is preserved through resample mean, min, and apply operations on a Series
test_metadata_propagation_concat: test that custom metadata propagates through pd.concat with a custom __finalize__ method
